family_reports.body: This system has wrongfully ripped away two children from a loving/involved father. The system has repeatedly violated my due process and ignored all factual evidence in its rulings.
This system has destroyed my once healthy relationship with our son. The life long negative effects have yet to be realized in our son. Has taken me many years to recover from this abuse.

They used the courts to turn a present, involved father into a visitor in his own children’s lives — and every professional appointed to protect those kids either looked the other way or made it worse. My children grew up primarily in my care, and now the parent who functioned more as a visitor has been elevated to full custody based on allegations that were false, misleading, or later contradicted by evidence. The emotional damage this has caused my children and our family is impossible to fully describe.
Permanent fracturing of child-mother bond. Orange County, CA = Complete Corruption!
Destroyed me emotionally and financially. Revoked my parental role.
